'''This Taloron''' served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to the [[Taloron Hunters|Taloron Hunter]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Crutag]]. When the [[Taloron]] lieutenant died during a hunt, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slimego]] assumed that he would eventually take the Taloron's place as Crutag's right-hand being.<ref name="CAV2" />
